text: 科净源公告，持有公司股份320万股、占总股本4.67%的股东上海平易缙元创业投资中心（有限合伙）因自身资金需要，拟于2026年9月29日至2026年12月28日通过集中竞价交易和大宗交易减持不超过205.5万股，占总股本不超过3.00%。
text_en: Kejingyuan announced that shareholder Shanghai Pingyi Jinyuan Venture Capital Center (Limited Partnership), holding 3.2 million shares of the company, accounting for 4.67% of total share capital, due to its own funding needs, plans to reduce its holdings by no more than 2.055 million shares through centralized bidding transactions and block trades from September 29, 2026, to December 28, 2026, accounting for no more than 3.00% of total share capital.
